entities.name: Balduvian Steppe
entities.description: Vast rocky plains north of the Karplusan Mountains on Terisiare, Dominaria; the breadbasket of New Argive.

entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: Mountain cluster in the northwest, infamous for goblins who went extinct during the Thaw.

entities.name: Kor Haven
entities.description: Ruins in the northeast, a remnant from the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Malpiri
entities.description: Barbarians of the Malpiri Plains replaced by or became the Balduvians.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: Barbarians who inhabited the steppe during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Monastery of Gix
entities.description: Landmark southwest of the Malpiri Plains.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: Covered the southwest of the steppe after the Flooding of Terisiare.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Displaced kor who adopted Balduvia's berserker ways.

entities.name: Shanid
entities.description: Paranoid, ruthless knight sent to the steppe to root out sleeper agents.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that displaced the kor to the steppe.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era when the Malpiri Plains became the Balduvian Steppe.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flood after which the Sea of Laments covered land in the southwest.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which Shanid was sent to the steppe.

events.summary: During the Ice Age the Malpiri Plains become known as the Balduvian Steppe.
events.quote: became known as the Balduvian Steppe during the Ice Age

events.summary: After the Flooding of Terisiare the Sea of Laments covers the southwest, making the steppe a peninsula.
events.quote: much of the land in the southwest of the steppe was covered by the Sea of Laments

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay displaced kor settle the steppe and adopt berserker ways.
events.quote: the steppes became home to displaced kor

events.summary: During the second Phyrexian invasion Shanid is sent to root out sleeper agents, burning villages.
events.quote: Shanid left a trail of burned villages in his wake.

relations.quote: on the continent of Terisiare on the plane of Dominaria
In the northeast lie the ruins of Kor Haven
